At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. 

Innovate with Tether 

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. 

But that’s just the beginning: 

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. 

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. 

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. 

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there. 

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front. 

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. 

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. 

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy 

- Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users. 

- Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it. 

- Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction. 

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage. 

Technical Product Leadership 

- Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions. 

- Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile. 

- Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom. 

- Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI 

- Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources. 

- Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership 

- Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives. 

- Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time. 

- Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments. 

- Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem. 

- Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed. 

Mobile & Distribution 

- Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management. 

- Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux. 

- Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data. 

Mandatory: 

- 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end. 

- Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more). 

- Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams. 

- Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself. 

- Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs. 

- Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management. 

- Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved. 

- Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts. 

- Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors. 

- A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information. 

- You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it. 

- Excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to have: 

- Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk. 

- Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus. 

- Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages. 

- A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products. 

- Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak). 

- A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing. 

- An engineering background or computer science degree. 

- Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools. 

Why this role: 

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you. 

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users. 

Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: 

- Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ 

- Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. 

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. 

- Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io 

- We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. 

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 

Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 

Functions of the Role The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.
- Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
- Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
- Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
- Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
- Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.

Experience - Essentials - Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
- 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
- Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
- Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
- Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.

Experience - Desirable - Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
- Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
- Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
- Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
- General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 

Benefits - Be part of a creative, world-leading team
- Competitive salary and share options scheme
- Contributory pension scheme
- Private Medical Insurance
- Life Assurance
- Cycle-to-work Scheme
- Flexible working
- Central London location (Islington)

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description:

With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technology and Cyber team are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Engineer to join the team. 

Baringa has grown so fast, and it continues to grow rapidly. Those new joiners keep on coming! We are a global function supporting the firm as it enters new markets. We are re-architecting and evolving our cloud-based business systems and infrastructure. We are on a mission to develop great technology products, deliver great services, and protect the trust our people and clients place in us. We have installed a new operating system for ourselves, and rebooted what was a corporate IT department into a corporate technology company, transforming the way we work.

Now we are building for the next era of work. AI is becoming part of the fabric of how Baringa operates, and we are developing the products and platforms that will help colleagues find knowledge, act on insight, navigate complexity, and get work done with greater speed, quality, and confidence. Some of this will be visible through intelligent experiences and agentic systems. Some of it will sit beneath the surface: data products, workflow platforms, integrations, automations, cyber security, governance, and the architecture that makes all of it safe, scalable, resilient, and useful.

So much to build on, so much to progress. So much to deliver. So much to play for!

Do you know what though? We are going to do it. All of it and more. We have the support to drive change. We have the belief. We are going to do great things. Come and join us!

What you will be doing 

- Design, build and support enterprise-grade integrations across Baringa’s business systems and technology platforms.

- Develop Azure Function App solutions that enable secure, reliable and scalable integration between strategic systems including Dynamics 365, Workday, Dataverse and other enterprise applications.

- Build and maintain custom APIs, services and integration components that support critical business processes and data flows.

- Design and implement integration patterns using Azure services including API Management, Service Bus, Storage Accounts and Key Vault.

- Support the ongoing modernisation of legacy integrations and data exchange processes, helping create more resilient and future-ready platforms.

- Own technical delivery from design through to deployment, support and continuous improvement.

- Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability and maintainability across the integration estate.

- Design solutions with appropriate security, monitoring, governance and operational controls, ensuring risks are understood and managed from the outset.

- Participate in troubleshooting, production support and incident resolution for business-critical integrations.

- Work closely with Product Owners, Engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.

Your skills and experience 

- Strong experience designing, building and supporting integrations using Azure Function Apps.

- Experience integrating Dynamics 365 applications using custom APIs and native integration capabilities.

- Strong understanding of REST APIs and modern integration design principles.

- Experience working with Azure integration services including API Management (APIM), Service Bus, Storage Accounts and Key Vault.

- Knowledge of Dataverse integration patterns and the wider Power Platform ecosystem.

- Experience designing and securing integration solutions using OAuth, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity and modern enterprise networking patterns, including private endpoints, network isolation and secure service-to-service communication.

- Ability to identify and mitigate technical, security and operational risks in integration solutions.

- Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, retry handling and support processes for production environments.

- Comfortable leveraging and building with frontier AI engineering tools and autonomous frameworks. You possess a strong architectural discipline, ensuring that while we aggressively push the boundaries of AI-assisted development, we do so with a rigorous commitment to code quality, safety, and governance.

What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting   People   First. 

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

- Generous Annual Leave Policy:  We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 

- Flexible Working:  We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Bilingual)
description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

- Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.

- Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.

- Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.

- Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.

- Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

- Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.

- Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.

- Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.

- Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.

- Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.

- Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.

- Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.

- Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.

- Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.

- Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.

- Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.

- Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.

- Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.

- B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.

- Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

- Fluent in French and/or German

Vous maîtrisez l’ensemble du PDLC : de la compréhension des enjeux business et utilisateurs jusqu’au delivery et à la mesure de la performance du produit. Vous savez également challenger les pratiques existantes et aider nos clients à renforcer leur maturité produit. 

Vos missions incluront : 

- Comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs et structurer la discovery , en mobilisant les parties prenantes pertinentes et en transformant leurs besoins et insights en problématiques et opportunités produit clairement définies. 

- Définir et porter la stratégie et la roadmap produit , en établissant des priorités claires et en arbitrant entre valeur utilisateur, impact business, faisabilité et contraintes. 

- Travailler étroitement avec le Design tout au long du processus de conception afin de challenger et valider les solutions proposées et de garantir leur adéquation avec les besoins utilisateurs et les objectifs business. 

- Créer un partenariat fort avec Engineering , afin d’assurer un alignement continu entre ambitions produit et réalités techniques, et de prendre ensemble les arbitrages nécessaires à la bonne conception et livraison du produit. 

- Créer l’alignement avec les parties prenantes senior , en communiquant clairement les choix et arbitrages produit et en assurant une visibilité régulière sur l’avancement du delivery et la performance du produit. 

- Utiliser l’IA comme levier d’efficacité du Product Management , en intégrant de manière pragmatique les outils GenAI aux différentes étapes du PDLC: recherche et synthèse d’insights, exploration, prototypage, formalisation des besoins, analyse ou documentation. 

- Faire progresser la maturité produit de nos clients , en identifiant les points de friction dans leurs pratiques, leur gouvernance ou leur operating model et en proposant des améliorations pragmatiques. 

Compétences et expériences désirées 

- Expérience significative en Product Management , avec un track record démontré dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux complexes. Une expérience du Product Management en environnement de conseil constitue un plus. 

- Capacité démontrée à être à la fois stratégique et hands-on : vous savez définir une vision produit et interagir avec des dirigeants, mais également entrer dans le détail d’une discovery, challenger une solution, prioriser un backlog ou contribuer à résoudre un problème de delivery lorsque nécessaire. 

- Maîtrise du PDLC de bout en bout, avec une capacité à coacher, piloter ou exécuter, selon les besoins clients 

- Solide compréhension des enjeux business et capacité à relier les décisions produit à des objectifs mesurables : croissance, revenus, réduction des coûts, expérience client, efficacité opérationnelle ou réduction des risques. 

- Capacité à construire un partenariat efficace avec Engineering , avec une bonne compréhension des problématiques de faisabilité, architecture, dette technique, dépendances et delivery, sans nécessairement être ingénieur. 

- Compréhension des enjeux business et réglementaires du secteur financier . Une expérience dans une fintech, banque digitale, institution financière ou cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important. 

- Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements ambigus, complexes et en transformation , avec un fort niveau d’autonomie, d’ownership et la capacité à créer de la structure lorsque celle-ci n’existe pas encore. 

- Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco? 

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel. 

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

Nos marqueurs distinctifs : 

- Une spécialisation sectorielle forte 
Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.

- Une approche collaborative et sur mesure 
Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.

- L’excellence comme exigence 
Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.

- Un esprit “One Capco” 
Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.

- Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive 
L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

description:
Who we are 

About Stripe 

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team 

The Stripe EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group dedicated to transforming customers into enthusiastic advocates for Stripe. Collaborating closely with sales, we focus on accelerating the path to purchase and enhancing product adoption among our user base. Our regional marketing efforts involve crafting and executing tailored marketing plans that resonate with local audiences, as well as spearheading our most significant conferences and sponsorships that drive go-to-market success and business growth. Join us and be part of a culture that celebrates teamwork, innovates boldly, and makes a meaningful impact.

What you’ll do 

We’re looking for a strategic, results-oriented marketing leader to drive our marketing engine for SMB and Mid-Market segments across EMEA, with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles. This segment represents a massive portion of Europe’s economic fabric and is a critical driver of our ambitions in the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence. You'll translate global priorities into locally resonant programs, ensuring that audiences in the SMB and Mid-Market space have high-quality, insight-driven experiences throughout their lifecycle, from early exploration to long-term partnership.

The ideal candidate is data-driven, has an unbridled passion for working hand-in-hand with regional sales teams to drive successful user outcomes, and is excited about building a high-velocity revenue engine.

Responsibilities 

- Define and execute the EMEA marketing strategy for SMB and Mid-Market segments with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles

- Own key business and revenue metrics throughout the sales funnel, with a strong emphasis on accelerating pipeline through upsell and cross-sell opportunities

- Collaborate with Partner Marketing to create successful co-selling initiatives that extend our reach within the partner and developer ecosystems

- Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel marketing plans, partnering with digital marketing and demand generation teams to secure high-value deals

- Partner closely with Sales leadership to align account plans, ensure disciplined lead follow-up, and establish trust as a strategic partner

- Collaborate with EMEA demand generation and product marketing to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content and marketing assets

- Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimizing for efficiency and scale while seeking to generate new global best practices, and innovate ways to educate a diverse range of personas about the value that Stripe delivers to businesses

Who you are 

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements 

- 7+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience in the EMEA technology market, including specific experience with demand generation and field marketing

- Proven track record of defining and executing B2B marketing strategies that successfully drive metrics, key performance indicators, and pipeline generation

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex topics with simplicity to diverse audiences

- Strategic mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making, along with a deep understanding of full-funnel journeys and marketing technology like Salesforce

- Experience scaling programs through agency resources and collaborating across key go-to-market stakeholders

Preferred qualifications 

- A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment

- Experience in the payments, financial technology, or adjacent industries, or marketing FinTech solutions or to FinTech companies

- Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems

- Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners

title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Toulouse, France
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview 

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward. 

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features

- Shape the future of our Android team

- Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features

- Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering

- Review pull requests, and support other teammates

- Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges 

- Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience

- Familiarity with Android components

- Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app

- Product design intuition and user empathy

- Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX

- Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests

- Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec

- Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests

- Excellent communication skills

- User oriented problem solving approach

- Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus: 

- Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android

- Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use: 

- Kotlin

- Kotlin Coroutines

- Kotlin Flow

- Jetpack Navigation

- Dagger 2

- Room

- Custom Views, Canvas & Paint

- Jetpack Compose

- JUnit

What We offer :

- A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.

- An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.

- A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.

- An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

- Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.

- Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

- Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.

- Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

description:
Staff Digital Product Designer – E-Commerce / Web Platform 

Department: E-Commerce & Customer Experience / Web Team

Level: Individual Contributor Lead (Staff Level)

Location: Lille / Paris 

1. Context & Project 

Decathlon's purpose is to bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all, guiding our overarching ambition to build a Local Human Bond and deliver accessible, unique sporting solutions globally. In this context, our goal is to build personalized, enriched experiences across all digital touchpoints and physical stores, leveraging Digital, Data, and AI to elevate the global customer journey.

The E-Commerce Web Challenge 

As the digital front door for millions of sport practice enthusiasts around the globe, our web platform (decathlon.country) must seamlessly convert online curiosity into real-world sport experiences. Our challenge is to transform a massive, multi-category web store into an intuitive, frictionless digital portal.

We need to guide every user—from a first-time visitor searching for sports goods to a returning member—through a smooth journey that connects online browsing directly with local store availability, click-and-collect, and circular services like rentals and repairs.

By building a standardized, modular web experience, we equip country teams and international franchise partners with pre-validated, high-converting funnel journeys so they can scale local commerce effortlessly without rebuilding core web experiences from scratch.

Scope & Structure (4 Dedicated E-Com Squads) 

- Acquisition: Turn global internet users into active visitors through high-converting landing experiences, SEO, campaign entry points, and personalized traffic onboarding.

- Navigation: Help users find the exact product or advice they need within a vast catalog through intelligent search, taxonomy, filtering, and catalog hierarchy.

- Decision: Give users every compelling reason to choose a product using rich product detail pages (PDP), media, sizing confidence, customer reviews, and circular/sustainability options.

- Conversion: Deliver frictionless checkout, flexible payment methods, order self-tracking, store pickup options, and effortless returns.

2. Your Mission 

As a Staff Digital Product Designer , you operate as a principal individual contributor and strategic leader within the Decathlon E-Commerce team. Operating with high autonomy on complex, cross-squad web challenges, you shape our long-term 

E-Commerce Web Experience Vision .

You will work in close triad leadership with Staff Engineering and Staff Product Managers (GPMs) , while partnering hand-in-hand with a dedicated UX Researcher (UXR) as your main practice partner to ground every design decision in deep user insights and quantitative data.

Beyond defining strategy, you lead hands-on experimentation, product de-risking, and rapid validation loops —ensuring high-stakes web features across Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion are proven through A/B testing, CRO analysis, and real user data before global rollout. You align the 4 web squads around a unified web vision, accelerate commercial value delivery, and elevate design craft maturity across teams.

3. What You’ll Do 

Strategic Alignment & Web Funnel Vision 

- Triad Leadership: Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Staff PMs, and your dedicated UXR partner to define long-term roadmaps, tech feasibility, and strategic UX priorities across squads.

- Web Experience Strategy: Define and advocate for the long-term web design strategy, establishing web principles that influence product and commercial roadmaps.

- 4-Squad Orchestration: Drive alignment across the Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion squads to ensure a cohesive end-to-end web journey without siloed user friction.

- Priority Segment Focus: Set strategic web UX direction tailored to key user segments ( Families, New Customers, Members ), driving personalization and context-aware landing journeys.

- Macro Metrics Tracking: Track and optimize web performance metrics across the full funnel: SEO Traffic, CTR, Search Success, Add-to-Cart Rate, Conversion Rate, and Retention .

Product De-Risking & Web Experimentation Strategy 

- Research Partner Alignment: Work hand-in-hand with UXR to formulate hypotheses, map user knowledge gaps, and design research strategies for complex e-commerce flows.

- De-Risking Frameworks: Formulate and drive product de-risking strategies for high-impact web initiatives—identifying usability, commercial, and technical risks early in discovery.

- Concrete Web Experimentation: Design and execute hands-on A/B tests, multivariate testing, CRO experiments, and prototype usability tests across the 4 squads to validate hypotheses before engineering rollouts.

- Data-Informed Decisions: Partner with Data & Analytics leads to build quantitative testing frameworks, leveraging web analytics to guide roadmap trade-offs.

- Testing Culture Elevation: Coach web product squads on hypothesis formulation, CRO best practices, and rapid build-measure-learn loops.

4. Role & Responsibilities (Skills & Behaviors) 

Craft / Technical Skills 

- Research & Web Strategy: Partner closely with our UXR to enrich foundational customer knowledge (B2C web journeys) and co-define a CX vision to build collective alignment across stakeholders.

- Problem Discovery: Uncover drop-off points across the 4 squads through quantitative funnel analytics and qualitative research; structure decisions using Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).

- Solution Discovery: Explore and prototype web interfaces early and often; design high-converting, accessible, and responsive layouts connected to our Design System.

- Testing & CRO: Continuously de-risk solution feasibility, usability, and conversion lift using context-tailored testing tools (A/B testing, user testing, CRO analytics).

- AI Exploration: Test and integrate AI tools (e.g., generative search, smart recommendations, automated layout testing) to amplify design and research workflows.

Behaviors / Soft Skills 

- Leadership & Strategic Collaboration: Lead cross-squad web taskforces alongside Staff Engineering and Staff PMs, make sound decisions under partial data, and support the Design Manager in org planning and hiring committees.

- Influence & Emotional Intelligence: Work proactively across PMs, Engineering Managers, and Business Leads to shape priorities using emotional intelligence and data-backed storytelling.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Involve engineering, data, UXR, and SEO teams early in the design process to create a psychologically safe, feedback-rich environment.

- Design Mentoring: Elevate the web design practice by mentoring 3–4 designers, facilitating cross-squad design critiques, and connecting design solutions across teams.

- Growth Mindset: Turn failed A/B experiments into collective learning opportunities and maintain a structured personal growth plan.

5. Why Join the E-Commerce Web Team? 

Challenges You Will Tackle 

- High-Scale Web Impact: Optimizing a global web platform handling millions of daily visits across dozens of international markets.

- 4-Squad Synergy: Unifying Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion into one fluid, frictionless web journey.

- Strong Triad Partnership: Working in direct alignment with Staff Engineering, Staff PMs, and a dedicated UXR partner to shape high-level product strategy.

- Performance & Accessibility at Scale: Designing lightweight, lightning-fast web pages that meet strict WCAG accessibility and SEO benchmarks.

This Role Is a Perfect Match for You If… 

- You thrive on de-risking web journeys via A/B testing and CRO data rather than subjective opinions.

- You excel at triad collaboration with Staff Tech and Staff PMs, backed by deep research partnership with UXR.

- You enjoy orchestrating design across multiple squads (Acquisition through Conversion) to deliver a unified customer experience.

- You balance commercial conversion into goals with high design standards and accessibility .

- You love mentoring designers and upskilling teams in experimentation, data literacy, and web craft excellence.

DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT 

What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Changing the game for good . We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Jobexit
description:
Notre mission ⚖️ 

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

- Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre

- Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)

- Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques

- Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat

- Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

Les à-côtés du poste 👁️ 
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :

- Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)

- Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)

- Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 

- Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.

- Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.

- Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.

- Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

Nos valeurs 🤝 

Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

- Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.

- Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.

- Knowledge is power : l 'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.

- Release early, release often and listen to your customers : n ous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️ 

🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀 

- Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine

- Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager , pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

- Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences

- Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

(si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles) 

Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater ! 

Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. 

Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! 

Diversité & inclusion 

Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement. 

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
About Ledger 

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team: 

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation. 

The role 

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

What you'll do 

Own French payroll 

- Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

- Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

- Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium

- Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis

- Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise

- Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships

- Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes

Run the employee lifecycle 

- Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data

- Keep Workday data accurate and compliant

- Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

- You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

What you bring 

- 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

- Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar)

- Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

- A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

- Comfort working in English in a multicultural team

- Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

- Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

- Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

- Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

- Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

- Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.

Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 

The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F

ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role 
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.

The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing 

- Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing

- Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting

- Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after

- Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up

- Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels

- Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce

- Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region

- Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration

- Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact

- Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

What you bring to the table 

- Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end

- International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market

title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

- Direction . The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
- Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
- Organisation . Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
- Leaders . Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
- Quality . Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
- Product interface . What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.

Your profile You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention. 

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold. 

YOUR EXPERIENCE - 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services. 
- 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you. 
- Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage. 
- You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume. 
- Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built. 

Why us? LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification. 

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it. 

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like. 

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market. 

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional. 

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Android/Kotlin
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot , based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. 

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 

Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.

➡️ Mission

Join us as an Android Engineer and help us build the mobile experience that 600,000+ European businesses rely on every day to manage their finances. You'll own product-critical features end-to-end — from technical design to rollout — in a large, modular Kotlin codebase where craft and velocity both matter. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Frontend.

➡️ What you'll do

- Own features end-to-end: You'll take ownership from discovery and technical design through implementation, rollout, and iteration on features that help businesses pay, get paid, and stay in control.

- Drive technical decisions in your squad: You'll shape solutions with Product, Design, and Backend by clarifying tradeoffs across UX, performance, security, and time-to-market.

- Raise app reliability and maintainability: You'll improve architecture, performance, and test strategy to scale the app without compromising stability.

- Tackle complex mobile challenges: You'll contribute to real-time synchronization, resilience patterns, and smooth navigation in a modular codebase with ~1,000 modules.

- Grow the team's Android craft: You'll lead code reviews and technical discussions, share patterns, and mentor peers to raise the bar on quality and delivery.

➡️ What we're looking for

- Strong Android native experience: You've shipped and maintained production features with Kotlin and are comfortable owning technical decisions end-to-end.

- Quality-driven mindset: You care about testing (unit, UI, snapshot), clean code, and pragmatic standards that keep teams moving fast.

- Problem-solving approach: You thrive in ambiguity and turn complex constraints into simple, robust solutions.

- AI-native workflow: You use AI coding tools daily to amplify your output — not just experiment with them.

- Collaborative by nature: You're fluent in English and contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

➡️ What we can offer you

- An AI-first engineering environment: Unlimited access to Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot — and a culture that expects you to use them to raise the bar, not just go faster (click here to read our vision statement on AI)

- Engineering standards that scale: Strong code review culture, continuous refactoring, and a focus on correctness in a regulated context.

- A technically demanding domain: Fintech constraints — security, compliance, real-time data — push you to solve problems most mobile engineers never encounter.

➡️ Our methodology, the Qonto Way 

- We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing — quality drives the velocity our customers need.

- Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates.

- Our lean toolbox, Kaizen and PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager.

Want to go further? Click here 

➡️ Our stack & practices

- Kotlin-first & modern concurrency : 100% Kotlin codebase with Coroutines + Flow throughout.
