title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. 
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. 
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture , working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints . You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas . You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements 

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

- Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
- Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
- Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
- Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
- Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
- Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
- Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 
You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow: 

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year 
Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

Longer term 
Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

--

What we're looking for:
We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

Must-have 

- PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
- Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
- Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
- Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
- Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
- Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
- Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise. 
- Professional English. 
Important, but you can grow here 

- Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
- Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
- Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
- Noise modelling. 
- Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
- Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 
Bonus 

- Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
- Photonic quantum computing. 
- Resource estimation. 
- Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
- Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

Benefits 

Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

- Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
- Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
- Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
- Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 
Plus: 

- Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
- Company savings plan.
- 100% health coverage through Alan. 
- Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
- Swile meal vouchers. 
- Access to Gymlib. 
Process 

- Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
- Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
- Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
- Reference checks 
- Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
- Offer 

For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

description:
About Agicap 

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. 

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. 

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. 

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. 

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! 

Home page 

Customer Stories 

Our Values 

⚡️ Le rôle 
Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe 

The mission 

At Lucis , we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here .

The role 

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead . You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own 

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support 

- Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

- Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

- NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process 

- Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

- Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

About you 

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

You’ll fit in well if 

- Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

- Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

- People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

- Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

- Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have 

- Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

- Startup Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution, and clear communication.

- Modern Tooling: Practical experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and boost support efficiency.

The process 

- Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

- Case study interview (30-60 min)

- Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

- Reference calls

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

- Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

- Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

- Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

description:
Demain, notre console recevra des milliards de requêtes. Votre mission : faire en sorte qu’elle tienne, et qu’elle reste rapide. Arkane Cloud crée un poste de Développeur Full Stack, à 80 % back-end, pour bâtir une plateforme taillée pour la charge. 

Notre société 

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure composée de centaines de GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique.

- Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler

- Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes.

Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

Pourquoi ce poste ? 

Notre console est le point d’entrée de nos clients : c’est là qu’ils déploient et pilotent leurs ressources GPU. Avec l’essor de l’IA, elle va devoir absorber une très grande quantité de requêtes. Nous créons ce poste pour la rendre robuste face aux pics de charge, développer les API qui la font tourner et installer les bonnes pratiques qui permettront à l’équipe de grandir. Votre temps se partage à 80 % sur le back-end et 20 % sur le front-end.

Vos missions 

• Tenir les pics de charge : une architecture qui absorbe le trafic sans ralentir.

• Développer nos API en Node.js : performantes, sécurisées, documentées.

• Installer les bonnes pratiques : revues de code, tests automatisés, monitoring.

• Optimiser la base de données PostgreSQL.

• Faire évoluer l’interface de la console en React.js (environ 20 % du temps).

Vos 6 premiers mois 

1er mois : Prise en main de la console et de son architecture, premier audit de performance, premières mises en production.

3 mois : Tests de charge en place, premiers points de blocage corrigés, bonnes pratiques formalisées.

6 mois : Console capable d’absorber n'importe quelle montée en charge, monitoring et alertes opérationnels.

Votre expérience 

• 5 ans ou plus en développement, avec une dominante back-end.

• Une expérience sur une plateforme grand public ou à fort trafic.

Vos expertises 

• Node.js : conception d’API robustes et performantes.

• React.js : à l’aise pour faire évoluer une interface existante.

• Montée en charge : cache, files d’attente, tests de charge, scalabilité.

Un vrai plus : 

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Votre façon de travailler : rigoureux sur la qualité, pragmatique, à l’aise pour partager vos pratiques avec l’équipe.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

• Un vrai défi technique : S'assurer de la robuste de la plateforme lors des montées en charge

• Un impact direct : Vos choix d’architecture façonnent la plateforme.

• Des standards à poser : c’est vous qui fixez le niveau d’exigence de l’équipe.

• Au cœur de l’IA : vos API pilotent une infrastructure GPU dédiée à l’IA.

Package et avantages 

• Télétravail 3 jours par semaine, présence au bureau de Lyon le mercredi et le jeudi

• Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec)

• Choix du matériel (PC ou Mac) & BSPCE

Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap.

title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

- Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

- Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

- Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

- Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

- Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

- Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

- Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

- Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

- Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

- Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

- Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

What We Want to Achieve Together 

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

Your profile - Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

- Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

- Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

- Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

- AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

- A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

- Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

Why us? - Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

- A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

- Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

- Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

Process - 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

- Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

- Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

- Meet the team in the office. 

- Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! 

How to Apply 

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description:
Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.

Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.

Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

2. Legal foundation. A law degree with a commercial-contracts focus: German-qualified (Bachelor, Master, or Staatsexamen) or an equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer.

3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome.

You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter.

4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus.

Why us? - Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate.
- No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title.
- We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one.
- Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP).
- Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible.
- Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together.

Process - Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are.
- Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going.
- Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves.
- Meet the team in our Zurich office.
- A mutual decision, before we welcome you to the team.

- Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
- Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.

title: SAP Industry Solution Advisor (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben Deine täglichen Aufgaben: 

- Du gestaltest Kundentermine, Workshops und Angebotsphasen in unseren Fokusbranchen Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defence und Automotive
- Du identifizierst die geschäftlichen und prozessualen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden in der diskreten Fertigung und leitest daraus passende Ansatzpunkte ab.
- Du führst Gespräche mit Fach- und IT-Entscheidern und übersetzt Anforderungen in überzeugende SAP-Lösungsbilder.
- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Beratungsteams klare Presales-Storylines, Präsentationen und Lösungsszenarien.
- Du zeigst auf, wie SAP S/4HANA und digitale Technologien Produktions- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse wirksam unterstützen können.
- Du übernimmst Verantwortung in komplexen Vertriebs- und Transformationssituationen und bringst Markt-, Branchen- und Kundenimpulse aktiv ein.

Dein Profil Die Anforderungen: 
- Du verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse in der diskreten Fertigung und kennst die Anforderungen produzierender Unternehmen.
- Du bringst Erfahrung in mindestens einer unserer Fokusbranchen mit: Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defense oder Automotive.
- Du hast fundierte SAP-Erfahrung aus der Beratung oder aus einem Industrieunternehmen und bewegst dich sicher in Transformationskontexten.
- Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Produktion, Supply Chain, Digitalisierung und SAP S/4HANA.
- Du hast idealerweise bereits als Projektleiter:in, Teilprojektleiter:in oder Stream Lead Verantwortung übernommen.
- Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturiert erfassen, in verständliche Lösungsszenarien übersetzen und diese sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch vermitteln.

Warum wir? Was Du unter anderem von uns erwarten kannst: 
- Attraktives Gehalt
- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Option
- Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation)
- Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
- Firmenwagen und moderne IT-Ausstattung
- Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Lerne ein Unternehmen kennen, in dem Menschen gut und gerne zusammenarbeiten – und finde hier weitere Benefits, die wir dir bieten.
Du erkennst dich in der Beschreibung wieder? Dann zögere nicht und nimm am besten noch heute Kontakt auf. Gerne können wir uns über diese Stelle und deine Möglichkeiten bei GAMBIT unterhalten.
Wir erwarten nicht, dass alle Kandidat:innen in allen genannten Bereichen gleich qualifiziert sind. Nenn uns daher gerne weitere, hier nicht genannte Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen, über die du verfügst und die für diese Stelle möglicherweise relevant sein könnten.
Ganz besonders wichtig ist uns, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen unser Verständnis von Arbeit und Zusammenarbeit teilen. Denn Arbeit ist für uns mehr als nur ein Job, Zusammenarbeit mehr als nur ein Nebeneinander. Wir legen Wert auf einen respektvollen, wertschätzenden Umgang, Fairness und einen offenen Dialog.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish -Speaking  - London, UK
description:
About Pallet 

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens) 

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us? 

- Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.

- Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.

- Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.

- Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.

- Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity 

We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.

How you will make an impact 

- Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.

- Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.

- Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.

- Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.

- Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.

- Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.

- Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.

- Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for 

- 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.

- Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. 

- Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.

- Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.

- Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.

- Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.

- Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.

- Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.

- Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.

- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model 

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time , providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

- Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.

- Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.

- Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.

Reporting structure 

You’ll report directly to the General Manager, London for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Sales , participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process 

- Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins

- Deal Review - 30 mins

- Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins

- Final Interview - ~3 hours

- Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation 

The estimated compensation range for this role is £100,000-£240,000 OTE , depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

- 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 

- 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation

- ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 

- ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

- 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff

- 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future

- 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families

- 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend

- 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees

- 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 

- 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space

- 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided 

- ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely

- 🥤 Monthly happy hours

- 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy 

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity 

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice 

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here .

Accommodations 

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Director, International Privacy Lead and Data Protection Officer
description:
Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer 

Overview 

Alnylam is seeking an experienced privacy and data protection leader to serve as Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Privacy, AI Governance, Training & Communications within Ethics & Compliance, this role will lead Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary responsibility for Europe (EU/EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland) and support for broader international markets.

As Alnylam’s formally appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) under applicable European and Swiss privacy laws, the Director will provide independent privacy oversight, advise the business on data protection obligations, and maintain direct access and escalation channels to senior leadership for material privacy risks.

This individual contributor will be expected to serve as a proactive partner to the our international business, anticipating privacy and data protection obligations driven by regulatory change and business growth, and translating those requirements into actionable guidance for policies, operations and ways of working.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement, Ethics & Compliance, and other business stakeholders to enable responsible use of personal data while strengthening privacy governance, risk management, and business adoption across international markets.

Hybrid role preferably based in Zug, Switzerland. Also open to candidates based in Madrid, Spain or Maidenhead, UK.

Responsibilities 

- Lead and mature Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary focus on Europe and support for broader international markets, by setting program priorities, strengthening governance frameworks, and ensuring privacy requirements are embedded into business planning, policies, controls, and day-to-day operations.

- Serve as Alnylam’s appointed DPO under EU GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable Swiss data protection requirements, providing independent advice, monitoring compliance, maintaining required independence, and acting as the primary point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.

- Oversee privacy risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and escalation processes, including privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, DPIAs, TIAs, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), cross-border transfer assessments, and related governance documentation.

- Advise business and functional leaders on privacy requirements related to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, commercial operations, medical affairs, human resources, patient support programs, real-world evidence, AI, and other data-driven initiatives.

- Partner with Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders on privacy incident response, breach assessment, third-party privacy risk management, data protection terms, data sharing arrangements, remediation, and regulatory notification decisions.

- Proactively monitor the European and international privacy, AI, digital, cyber and data governance legislative landscape, anticipating compliance impacts from business growth and regulatory change, and rapidly translating new or changing requirements into practical updates to policies, controls, business processes, training, and operational guidance.

- Develop and deliver privacy training, communications, awareness initiatives, metrics, monitoring activities, and continuous improvement plans that promote a culture of privacy and accountability across international markets.

Qualifications 

Required 

- Juris Doctor (JD), LLM, or other advanced legal degree required.

- 12+ years of privacy legal or compliance experience at a law firm and/or in-house.

- Significant experience advising on privacy risk in regulated life sciences settings, including clinical research, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, commercial, HR, patient-facing, and digital activities.

- Experience serving as a DPO or advising in an equivalent independent oversight capacity for GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, or comparable privacy regimes.

- Deep understanding of GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, international data transfer requirements, and global privacy regulations.

- Experience advising on AI, data-driven innovation, real-world evidence, cross-border data use, and other strategic privacy initiatives.

- Strong privacy governance and risk management experience, including the ability to set priorities, mature program controls, and translate complex requirements into practical guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the credibility and judgment to engage senior leaders, regulators, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead complex privacy initiatives across matrixed, international organizations, applying practical and proportionate judgment to ambiguous issues.

- Executive presence, regulatory credibility, and strategic judgment to anticipate legal, business, and technology shifts and translate them into clear priorities for the international privacy program.

Preferred 

- Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or similar credentials preferred.

- Experience interacting directly with European data protection authorities and regulators preferred.

- Experience leading multinational privacy teams or global privacy programs preferred.

- International business experience within a global life sciences organization preferred.

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission 

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role 

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture 

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do 

- Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

- Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

- Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

- Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

- Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

- Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for 

- Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

- Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

- Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

- Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

- A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect: 

- Competitive salary and stock options

- Flexible working hours

- Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs: 

- We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

- We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

- We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

- Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

- Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

- Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

- Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

- Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

- Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

Your Background

- 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

- Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

- UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

- Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

- Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

Nice to Have

- Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

- Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

- Building a design system from scratch.

- Defence or regulated customers.

What We Offer

- Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

- Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

- Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

- Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

- Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

- Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

- Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

- Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

- Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures.

- Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot.

- Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it.

- Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours.

Who We're Looking For

A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots.

Your Background

- 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments.

- Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered.

- Strong Python; C++ a plus.

- 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD.

- GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows.

Nice to Have

- Legged robots.

- Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction.

- ROS 2.

- Thermal or lidar sensor modelling.

- Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

- Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

- Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

- World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

- Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

- Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

- Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

- Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

- Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

- Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

- Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

- Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

- Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

- Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

- Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

- 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

- Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

- Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

- Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

- Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

- Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

- ROS 2.

- Hardware-in-the-loop rigs and bench automation.

- Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

- Functional safety or comparable standards work.

- On-prem, air-gapped or defence deployment experience.

- Having been on call for hardware in the field.

title: Brand Manager
description:
About Flink 

Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics.

We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it.

The role 

You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome.

What you'll do 

- Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent.

- Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed.

- Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do.

- Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels.

- Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class.

- Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable.

- Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe.

- Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink.

- Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it.

What you bring 

- A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great.

- Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things

- Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media

- A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count

- Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build

- First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count)

Nice to have 

- German (spoken or written)

- Photo or video shooting and editing skills

- Experience with website design

- Interior design, set design or event production experience

- Previous startup or tech-company experience

What we offer 

- The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise

- Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one

- Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world

- A growing, ambitious team in Zürich

- Competitive salary and employee stock options

- Budget and freedom to try new ideas

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Overview 

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. 

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. 

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role 

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do 

- Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

- Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

- Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

- Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

- Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

- Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

- Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are 

- A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

- Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

- Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

- A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

- High ownership and bias toward action.

- Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

- Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

- Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

- A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

- Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements 

- Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

- Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

- Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

- Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. 

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. 

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Industrialization
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly. 

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission. 

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment. 

The Opportunity

You will join the Industrialization team, the group that turns ANYmal from something engineers can build into something a factory can build, test, and release at volume. Every robot that leaves our production line passes through the test systems this team owns. When those tests are effective, quality issues are caught in Zurich before reaching a customer's industrial site. That is the leverage of this role.Sitting directly at the intersection of software and hardware, you will write Python code to interface with physical devices, help define reliable pass/fail criteria for ANYmal subsystems, and deploy test routines to our manufacturing shopfloor. Working alongside Manufacturing Engineers, test technicians, and hardware design teams, you will gain hands-on experience bridging cutting-edge robotics design with scalable industrial production.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, we build autonomous mobile robots (ANYmal) that solve complex inspection tasks in challenging industrial environments such as energy, chemical, and mining facilities.
