title: Lead Software Engineer - Paris
description:
Présentation du poste : 

Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.

Ce qu’on attend de vous : 

En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.

Vos missions : 

- Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).

- Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.

- Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.

- Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.

- Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.

- Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.

- Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.

Profil recherché : 

- Expérience & Leadership : Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.

- Résolution de problèmes : Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.

- Management & Transmission : Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.

- Spécialisations (au moins 1) : Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.

- Stack technique : Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).

Process de recrutement : 

- HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.

- Technical Deep Dive (60 min) : Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.

- US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package : 75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. title: Post-doctorant·e en apprentissage décentralisé sûr, conficentiel et explicable - CDD 12 mois
description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis 

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom 

Missions

- Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

- Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée ( Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML ) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

- Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

- Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées ( backdoors ) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

- Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles , notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

- Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

- Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

- Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

- Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée , en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

- Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

- Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche , notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

- Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance, 

Activités

- Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

- Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité , en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

- Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

- Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

- Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité , en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

- Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

- Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré , notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé ( Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC ).

- Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

- Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité , notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité.

- Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement , en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité.

- Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes ( label poisoning ) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés.

- Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité , notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants.

- Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle , en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications.

- Définir des protocoles et métriques d’évaluation permettant de comparer les approches proposées selon différents niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse, de fidélité des explications et de coût computationnel.

title: Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets
description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement .

Intégré au pôle Assurance Qualité Qualification, Validation & Projets, vous serez le représentant de l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets . Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité.

Vos missions : 

- Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements. 
- Définir et rédiger la documentation Qualité associée aux projets, notamment les besoins utilisateurs, cahiers des charges, plans directeurs de validation et rapports associés. 
- Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire . 
- Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place. 
- Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP , selon les besoins des projets. 
- Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie. 
- Revoir et contribuer à la rédaction des procédures, modes opératoires et autres documents Qualité nécessaires à la mise en exploitation. 
- Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes. 
- Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets. 
- Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations.
Requirements 

Chez Excelya, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels rigoureux, autonomes et capables de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.

- Expérience : Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Assurance Qualité et Qualification/Validation dans l'industrie pharmaceutique . 
- Expertise procédés : Vous possédez idéalement une expérience dans les procédés de formes sèches , notamment en extrusion, granulation sur LAF, compression et/ou conditionnement . 
- Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés. 
- Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP . 
- Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA , de l' Annexe 15 des EU GMP , du 21 CFR Part 11 , des principes GAMP 5 , ICH Q9 et ALCOA+ . 
- Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent. 
- Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet. 
- Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum , permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.
Benefits 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences.

En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation. 

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate !

Accueil et relation client 

- Accueillir chaque client, conseiller sur la carte, créer une expérience à la hauteur de l'image de la Maison

- Faire le lien avec les équipes de la boutique : le Café et le Retail partagent le même espace et la même clientèle

- Suivi des niveaux de stock (café, lait, consommables, packaging)

- Passage des commandes fournisseurs et relation directe avec eux (torréfacteur, grossistes, consommables)

- Réception et contrôle des livraisons, gestion des DLC, limitation des pertes

- Inventaires réguliers et remontée des écarts

Gestion du matériel 

- Nettoyage quotidien et hebdomadaire des machines, du moulin et de l'ensemble du poste

- Planification et suivi des maintenances préventives, gestion de la relation avec les techniciens

- Détection et signalement des dysfonctionnements, gestion des interventions curatives

- Respect et suivi des règles d'hygiène applicables au poste

Encadrement 

- Encadrer et former le second barista : gestes techniques, standards de service, montée en compétence

- Organiser les plannings du binôme et la répartition des tâches

- Participer aux recrutements à venir : définition du besoin, entretiens, intégration des nouveaux arrivants

- Expérience confirmée en tant que barista en coffee shop de spécialité (2 à 3 ans minimum)

-Maîtrise technique : réglages, extraction, latte art

-Autonomie démontrée sur les stocks et la relation fournisseurs

-À l'aise avec l'entretien et la maintenance courante du matériel

-Connaissance de la filière café de spécialité (torréfacteurs, sourcing, tendances)

- Vous êtes curieux.se et avez envie de vous investir dans un tout nouveau projet.

- Vous êtes souriant.e, dynamique, impliqué.e et doté.e d'excellentes qualités relationnelles.

- Vous avez un sens développé du service client et avez à cœur de satisfaire les besoins de la clientèle.

- Vous avez une forte sensibilité pour la Mode et à l'univers de la marque

- La pratique de l'anglais est indispensable .

- Date de démarrage : 15 novembre.

Why join the « F.ami.LY »? 

Ami Paris se distingue par la sincérité de son expression. Nous réunissons des personnes passionnées et motivées, qui travaillent avec cœur et une énergie positive dans un cadre respectueux. Chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à créer un environnement dynamique, ou créativité et engagement vont de pair.

Rejoignez une Maison de mode en pleine croissance, engagée et bienveillante, où chacun peut apporter sa personnalité et contribuer à une aventure collective.

Nous recherchons des personnalités qui savent créer du lien, prendre des initiatives et faire preuve d’implication. Chez Ami, la qualité de l’expérience client repose autant sur le savoir-faire que sur le savoir-être : confiance, optimisme, créativité, engagement et esprit d’équipe.

Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

Deine Rolle bei June 

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 

- Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

- Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

- Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

- Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

- AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

- Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

Das wäre ein Plus 

- Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

- Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 

- Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

- Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

- Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

- Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

- Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

- Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

So arbeiten wir 

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 

- Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

- Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

- Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

- Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

- Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

- Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

- Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

- Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
description:
Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible .

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.

Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter. 

What convinces us Your personality, paired with:
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
- Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems - this is your core strength
- Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
- Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
- Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
- Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
- Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
- Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
- Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
- Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. 

Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. 
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. 

Additionally, we offer: 
- great freedom for your creative ideas.
- ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
- Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
- support with your relocation
- a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
- 30-day vacation by default.
- an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
- attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
- unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.

description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. 

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

The Data & Measurement team makes sure every interaction on our website and apps is measured accurately, reliably and in a privacy-compliant way. We own the tracking architecture (Google Tag Manager web and server-side, GA4, advertising platform tags) across 17 markets. The data we collect powers marketing performance, product analytics and business decisions across the company.

Be a part of the movement. Join the circular revolution. 

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 

- Implement and maintain tags, triggers and variables in our Google Tag Manager containers (web and server-side), for analytics and advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.

- Specify and QA dataLayer events with our developers, and make sure new features ship with the right tracking.

- Run tracking audits and QA across markets: detect broken or missing events, investigate data discrepancies, and follow fixes through to production.

- Contribute to tracking monitoring by building checks and alerts on data quality in BigQuery.

- Make sure tracking respects user consent choices and privacy regulations, working with our consent management platform and legal teams.

- Keep our tracking plan and documentation up to date, so every team knows what is collected and why.

- Answer tracking questions from Marketing, Product and Data teams, and help them trust the numbers.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ 

- You are in the final year of a Master's degree in engineering, business, data or digital marketing (or equivalent), looking for a 6-month internship.

- You have a first experience or a strong interest in web analytics and tag management (GTM, GA4 or similar).

- You understand JavaScript and can read, debug and write simple scripts, and you are comfortable with HTML and browser developer tools.

- You know some SQL, or want to get hands-on with BigQuery.

- You care about data quality and details, and enjoy investigating why a number looks wrong.

- You have an interest in privacy and consent topics (GDPR, cookies, CMPs).

- You communicate clearly and are comfortable working with developers, marketers and analysts.

- You are fluent in French and English (both are mandatory).

BONUS POINT : Knowledge of server-side tagging, experience with an advertising platform (Google Ads, Meta), or a personal project involving tracking or data.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: 

- Start date: January 2027

- Duration : 6 months

- Full-time internship (35h/week)

- Location : Paris (France)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 

- Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min)

- Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)

- Cultural fit interview with the manager (30min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

- Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

Own the knowledge base

- Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

Improve support with AI

- Identify where automation and AI tools (triage, routing, response drafting, knowledge retrieval) would save time or improve quality

title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
Who We Are 

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role 

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/ 

About You 

- 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

- Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems

- Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects

- Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on

- A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft

- Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system

- Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms

- Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales

- Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality

- Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale 

- Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics

- Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation 

$ 178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. 

Hiring Process 

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire .

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that: 

- You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

- Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

- While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

- A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

- By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process 

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles: 

- Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

- Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

- Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at Compensation: $178.5K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture

Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 

About the Job 

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.

What you'll do 

Architecture 

- 
Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

- 
Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

- 
Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

- 
Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

- 
Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

Configuration & tooling 

- 
Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

- 
Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

- 
Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure

What we're looking for 

Required 

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

- 
5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

- 
Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

- 
Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

- 
High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

Nice to have 

- 
Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

- 
Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

- 
Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

- 
Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

This role is a great fit if… 

- 
You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

- 
You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

- 
You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

- 
You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

- 
You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

Responsibilities 

- Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

- MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

- Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

- BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

- High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

- EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

- Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

- Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

- Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

- Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

Candidate Requirements

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning! 

We are looking for... 

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will... 

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need... 

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have... 

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum 

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get 

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits 

- Competitive compensation including equity package

- Competitive vacation policy

- Medical Insurance

- L&D budget

- Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

- Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values 

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Financial Crime Compliance & Market Conduct
description:
Joining Capco means becoming part of an innovative and dynamic consultancy firm, committed to fostering an inclusive environment where you are encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We embrace individuality as a key factor in promoting diversity and inclusion, values that sit at the core of our success. We aim to attract a wide variety of talented professionals with different skills and experiences. If you require any adjustments to support your application process, please feel free to inform us at any stage.

ABOUT CAPCO 

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy that is passionate about supporting clients in the financial services sector to grow and succeed in today's ever-changing world. We are:

- Experts in banking, capital markets, payments and asset and wealth management.

- Trusted advisors in core banking, securities and wealth management transformation, regulatory change, risk management and technology modernization.

- A company dedicated to continuous development and excited to welcome top talent to help us drive innovation and deliver lasting results.

- A business built on agility, collaboration, and entrepreneurial spirit.

THE ROLE 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to help shape the strategic transformation of our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) and Market Conduct & Trade Surveillance (MCTS) capabilities within Legal & Compliance.

Working at the intersection of compliance, business, technology, architecture and data, you will shape strategic target states, assess current capabilities and translate business and control objectives into prioritised transformation roadmaps and actionable requirements. You will facilitate complex cross-functional decisions and provide clear recommendations to senior management.

You will act as the senior business-analysis and transformation lead for selected FCC and MCTS initiatives, shaping target states and roadmaps while working in close partnership with Compliance, Technology, Architecture, Data and Programme Management.

YOUR CAPCO DAY 

- Lead the business definition of strategic target states, facilitating alignment across Compliance, Technology, Architecture and Data and ensuring that agreed target states are translated into actionable transformation plans.

- Assess current capabilities and conduct gap analyses across processes, organisation, systems, architecture, data quality and governance, translating findings into prioritised transformation measures and investment considerations.

- Define business and technology requirements and develop relevant use cases and options, including opportunities to improve data quality, reduce false positives, automate and scale alert handling, and strengthen monitoring and surveillance processes.

- Translate target states into structured multi-year transformation roadmaps, defining priorities, milestones, dependencies, sequencing, responsibilities, investment considerations and key trade-offs across risk reduction, regulatory need, business value and delivery feasibility. Facilitate cross-functional decision-making across business, technology and control functions, frame key options and trade-offs, and prepare concise recommendations and decision materials for senior management. Define measurable transformation outcomes and success criteria, such as improved control effectiveness, reduced manual effort and false positives, better data quality and lineage, increased automation, and improved operational scalability.

- Ensure traceability from regulatory, policy and control objectives through business requirements, solution design and implementation outcomes.

YOUR CAPCO FIT 

- Demonstrated Financial Crime Compliance expertise combined with project and ideally consulting experience in the design and digital transformation of FCC solutions within a comparable financial-services environment.

- Strong ability to work across business architecture, solution/enterprise architecture and data disciplines, translating business and control requirements into architectural, process and data implications.” Strong expertise in Financial Crime Compliance, with deep experience in one or more core domains such as AML/CTF, sanctions or PEP screening, and sufficient breadth to work effectively across adjacent FCC areas including tax compliance.Proven change and organisational capabilities, particularly stakeholder management and facilitation, Target Operating Model definition and the preparation of decision materials for senior management.

- Strong conceptual and analytical capabilities, with experience translating strategic target states into prioritised multi-year roadmaps and implementation plans within complex transformation environments.

- Fluent English and German are a must for this role. 

BONUS POINTS FOR 

- Experience within Market Conduct, Trade Surveillance or comparable monitoring and surveillance environments; deep MCTS expertise is advantageous but not required where the candidate brings strong transferable FCC transformation experience.

- Experience developing strategic concepts spanning Financial Crime Compliance, Legal & Compliance and wider banking transformation.

- Familiarity with surveillance challenges such as false-positive reduction, alert management, data quality and the integration of relevant communications and market information.

- Experience assessing investment requirements and prioritising transformation initiatives across three-to-five-year roadmaps.

- Experience coordinating transformation plans with wider enterprise architecture, technology or bank-wide strategic programmes.

Ready to take the Next Step 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in Switzerland. 

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.

Accountabilities 

- Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.

- Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.

- Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.

- Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.

- Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.

- Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.

- Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).

- Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding.

- Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads.

- Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.

- Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies.

- Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

Requirements:

- Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.

- Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.

- Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices.

- Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.

- Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment.

- Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones.

- Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware.

- Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges.

- Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems.

- Knowledge of distributed inference techniques, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU clusters.

- Deep understanding of the mathematical foundations and architecture of diffusion models and Vision Transformers.

- Familiarity with modern inference optimization techniques including pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV Cache optimization, and speculative decoding such as EAGLE.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an ability to investigate complex system bottlenecks and turn research findings into practical engineering solutions.

- Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional technical teams.

Benefits:

- Opportunity to work on advanced AI systems spanning model serving, inference optimization, mobile computing, edge deployment, and large-scale distributed inference.

- Remote-first working environment with an international team.

- Exposure to cutting-edge AI research and practical systems engineering challenges.

- Opportunity to contribute to performance-critical infrastructure where improvements can have a measurable impact on real-world AI applications.

- Collaborative environment combining research-driven experimentation with hands-on engineering.

- Opportunity to work with advanced model architectures including diffusion models, Vision Transformers, and multimodal systems.

title: Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, EMEA
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE 

As Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, Business Development (EMEA), you will partner with EMEA Sales and Sales Engineering leaders to shape and execute the region’s HLS growth strategy. You will connect market opportunity to field execution: prioritizing segments and accounts, developing repeatable vertical and horizontal plays, strengthening the organization and partner ecosystem, and leading critical customer and alliance initiatives. You will be expected to operate comfortably at three levels:

● Strategic: Define where and how Everpure should win in European healthcare and life sciences.

● Organizational: Build the capabilities, coverage, relationships, and operating cadence required to scale.

● Commercial: Personally advance priority opportunities, alliances, and executive relationships to closed business and measurable customer value.

The role requires a combination of HLS credibility, technical fluency in data and AI platforms, commercial ownership, and the ability to influence across country sales, SE, partners, and corporate teams without relying on formal authority.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Own the Pipeline & Financial Performance: Own the booking targets and financial performance for the segment by developing and executing a multi year strategic growth plan. Drive and scale the overarching pipeline and bookings targets across the EMEA ecosystem, establishing clear qualification criteria and pipeline visibility. 

Define the EMEA Value Proposition: Define and articulate the value proposition for Healthcare & Life Sciences to drive growth and establish Everpure as the industry leader. 

Architect & Execute Joint GTM Plans: Author and launch strategic go-to-market plans with priority partners, aligning internal cross-functional EMEA teams (Partner Account Teams, Core Sales, Alliances, Marketing) to unlock high-potential HLS customer accounts and activate new revenue streams.

Orchestrate Strategic Alliances: Orchestrate strategic vertical alliances and operationalize relationships with key partners to secure reference architectures and joint go to market motions. 

Enable and Mobilize the Partner Ecosystem: Equip sales teams and partners with the specialized tools, training, and playbooks they need to successfully position and sell vertical solutions. Train and align Partner representatives ensuring they can effectively articulate our value proposition, economic differentiation, and technical sizing for healthcare compliance. 

Drive Joint Demand Gen & Thought Leadership: Act as a spokesperson for your vertical vision in customer meetings, industry events, analyst briefings, and media opportunities. Build credibility as a principal advisor by shaping the industry narrative around intelligent data foundations and enterprise AI adoption.

WHAT YOU BRING 

HLS & Alliance Expertise: Proven success leading strategic business development or alliance management within the technology sector, with a deep understanding of customers solutions, cloud economics, and the specific regulatory, data, and compliance needs of the EMEA Healthcare and Life Sciences sector.

Cross-Functional Influence & Execution: Develop and execute the global strategy for your segment in partnership with Product Management, Sales, and Engineering teams. A track record of balancing high-level strategy with a "roll-up-your-sleeves" execution mindset, showing a strong ability to build trust and influence executive leaders across partner organizations.

Agile Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding business acumen and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to thriving in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and multi-cultural EMEA environment.

Location & Travel: We operate in a hybrid/field-based model. You will be expected to work effectively from a regional corporate office in a key EMEA market, with the ability to travel 25–40% across the region as business needs require.

title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer 

About Share 

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role 

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do 

- Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

- Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

- Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

- Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

- Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

- Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

- Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

- Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate 

- 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

- Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

- Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

- Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

- You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

- You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

- AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

- You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

- A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have 

- Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

- Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

- Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

- 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

- Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

- Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

- DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits 

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)
