title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners .

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. 

Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. 

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. 

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations 

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition. 

The Role

We are looking for engineers who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a diverse and vibrant company. As a senior software engineer you will have the opportunity to work across the entire stack with a focus on the back-end. You will have the opportunity to learn and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.

We are open to candidates from Canada, the United States, and Colombia.

What You’ll Do

- Ownership over large domains and features related to card processing/issuing, and core ledgering of financial transactions

- Play a critical role in the development, design, and maintenance of Flex's platform and services.

- Architect well thought-out services and data models that ensure Flex's continued growth

- Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from api contracts, data, scalability, security, observability, and metrics.

- Lead by example and mentor engineers in all aspects of planning, development and testing.

- Be a catalyst for driving best-in-class technology frameworks and tooling while staying engaged with the latest technology trends.

- Be on call, with the expectation to ability to solve problems and find solutions for the servicing team

What You Need

- Proficiency in NodeJS+Typescript and server design principles.

- An understanding and interest in architectural patterns for highly available, scalable, low-latency, asynchronous systems

- Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards.

- Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to provide in-depth evaluation of multiple technical directions and determine tradeoffs of each.

- Strong propensity to make data-driven decisions on technical architecture and project prioritization.

- Exposure to modular monoliths and micro-services along with the benefits and challenges they bring.

- Experience with any cloud based provider like Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

- Four or more years of relevant industry experience with a track record of shipping high-quality products and features at scale.

- A strong work ethic and are ready to grind

- Have built and shipped a working project or product, ideally something complex 

Compensation

Additional Information

Interested? We'd love to hear from you 

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one 

Why Join Us 

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

title: Software Backend Engineer - Senior / Confirmed (Paris or Remote France)
description:
About Alma 

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team 

We are hiring for different squads. We will direct you to a specific team depending on your interests and skills.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris or remote from France.

About the job 

Build the payment infrastructure of tomorrow 

- Design and develop the APIs and backend components that power payments for thousands of merchants and millions of consumers across Europe.

Raise the bar on quality, security & performance 

- Write maintainable, production-grade code that meets the highest standards of a regulated company processing billions of euros.

Shape our technical architecture 

- Collaborate closely with Product and other tech leaders to evolve our architecture in line with growing business needs.

Own reliability end-to-end 

- Lead incident response and performance troubleshooting, driving long-term improvements to ensure our platform stays resilient at scale.

You will work with 

Python, Docker, React, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pub/Sub, Datadog

About you 

To succeed in this job 

- 8+ years of experience in backend engineering on large-scale systems (excluding internships and apprenticeships)

- Strong proficiency in Python and relational databases — we're open to other backend languages, but Python is our core stack

- Fluency in French with a solid level of English

- Methodical, with strong communication and problem-solving skills; at ease working in a cross-functional environment

And it will be nice if you also 

- Have experience building payment or financial solutions 

- Have a track record of influencing product and technical decisions at scale

- Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. 

What's in it for you 

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Real-world scale — your code will directly power payments for millions of consumers and tens of thousands of merchants across Europe.

- Technical ownership — you'll have genuine influence over architecture decisions, not just implementation.

- A regulated, fast-moving environment — you'll tackle the unique challenges of building robust, secure fintech infrastructure in a company that's still moving fast.

Compensation & benefits 

- Competitive salary based on 12 months

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan 

- Health insurance : 100% covered by Alma including family package

- Disability insurance : 100% covered by Alma

- Sport : partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass , or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

- Maternity/paternity leave : salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

- Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD) : €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)

- Meal vouchers : €10/day , 50% covered by Alma

- Mental health: free access to MindDay platform

- Paid time off : 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)

- Access to our Learning & Development Platform 

- 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process 

- Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.

- Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.

- Take-home coding test , followed by a remote feedback session.

- Live system design interview to assess your practical and architectural knowledge.

- A coffee chat with the squad you’ll join to further assess your skills and team fit.

More information on the hiring process can be found in our Interview Guide .

Diversity & Inclusion 

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role 

Location: Remote, United States, Europe, Canada or LATAM

Role-Type: Full-Time

Reports To: VP of Engineering

Compensation: $170,000 to $190,000 per year for US based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.

CodePath’s educational programs run on our sophisticated learning platform, a set of Ruby-based applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can lead at multiple levels at once: the architecture, the product direction, the team's capacity, and the longer arc of where we're going. You'll move fluidly across the full technical stack, from infrastructure decisions to greenfield product work. 

This is a high-ownership role. You'll work directly with stakeholders to understand what students and staff actually need, participate in deciding what gets built, and then lead the execution. You won't be handed a ticket queue. You'll shape the work. 

The ideal candidate for this role is a web engineer inspired by potential projects like these: 

- 
Building brand-new functionality in Rails and beyond to create sophisticated and powerful new tools for our users and extend our reach to new kinds of learners we’ve never been able to serve before

- 
Reimagining core platform components as we migrate them from Sinatra to Rails

- 
Integrating AI/ML technology into our platform to support mastery-driven, adaptive learning

- 
Scaling a system that has helped tens of thousands of students to help hundreds of thousands more

Key Activities 

- 
Architect and build web applications across Ruby on Rails, Sinatra/Padrino, and Django that directly support our mission

- 
Make consequential technical decisions on infrastructure, data modeling, API design, and emerging technologies with full ownership of the tradeoffs

- 
Set the code quality bar through reviews, architectural guidance, and constructive feedback

- 
Write automated tests that reflect real edge cases, not just coverage targets

- 
Identify performance bottlenecks and systemic issues before they become outages

- 
Mentor other engineers and raise the technical ceiling of the team

Qualifications 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years with Ruby on Rails

- 
Familiarity with Claude Code or similar development tools and related best practices

- 
A systems-thinking orientation: you consider scalability, maintainability, and failure modes before writing a line of code

- Strong PostgreSQL and database design skills, including experience with complex queries, indexing strategies, and schema evolution

- 
Reasonable working familiarity with the full web stack, from infrastructure to CSS

- 
Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions in a small, autonomous team environment

- 
Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a non-engineer without losing what actually matters

- 
Passion for education and desire to make a positive impact

Nice to haves 

- 
Familiarity with higher education or edtech

- 
Direct experience working with LLMs and generative AI in production

- 
Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, and/or Terraform

- 
Experience deploying on GCP

Full-Time Employee Benefits: 

This is a 100% remote position! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

- 
Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

- 
Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

- 
Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

- 
Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

- 
​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

- 
Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$170,000—$190,000 USD

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI CICD)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Customer Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role: 

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

- Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.

- Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.

- Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.

- Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Poland.

In this role, you will: 

- Build foundational capabilities for Samsara’s agentic experiences, enabling AI agents to securely discover data, use tools, integrate with external systems, and execute reliable workflows at enterprise scale.

- Design systems for high throughput, availability, observability, security, and maintainability.

- Apply AI assistants, including Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor - across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.

- Improve frameworks, tooling, and engineering practices that increase the effectiveness of teams across Samsara.

- Mentor other engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team 

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 4+ years of relevant engineering experience , with a track record of shipping and improving production software.

- Proven end-to-end ownership of a product, substantial feature, or subsystem through design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

- Ability to take a clear customer or business challenge, independently choose a technical approach, and balance delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.

- Experience driving delivery with engineers and product or design partners, and helping teammates improve through reviews, technical feedback, or mentoring.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Canvas Core
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural ’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas.

We’re also responsible for the Mural UI, the real-time message protocol that enables seamless remote collaboration, and the developer-friendly APIs that internal teams use to build features like diagramming, workshops, presentations, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

Our mission is to ensure the Mural editor is fast, reliable, intuitive, and easy to build on.

We prioritize performance, simplicity, developer experience, and platform quality, enabling teams across the company to ship quickly and safely on top of Canvas Core.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and improve the Canvas platform so that the Mural editor remains reliable, high-performing, and intuitive for our users.

You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor.

Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ambiguous product and platform problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. They help raise the bar for their team through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring, documentation, and pragmatic improvements to engineering practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- 
Own and deliver new Canvas platform capabilities and improvements from problem definition through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration

- 
Partner with Product and Design to shape high-quality user experiences, balancing pragmatic technical delivery with long-term platform needs

- 
Design and build maintainable Canvas platform systems, with accountability for quality, performance, reliability, and developer experience

- 
Contribute to developer-friendly APIs, service boundaries, and platform contracts that internal teams can build on quickly and safely

- 
Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows as part of your engineering practice to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure work effectively

- 
Strengthen the team through technical design reviews, demos, code reviews, mentoring, and improvements to engineering practices

- 
Build and evolve canvas systems with rich document and object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, and selection mechanics

- 
Work on large-scale concurrent and real-time collaboration systems that keep shared documents synchronized across users, contributing to design decisions around event ordering, latency, conflict handling, and failure-mode management

- 
Help design, build, and integrate AI-enabled product capabilities where they intersect with the canvas, document model, real-time collaboration systems, or developer platform

- 
Improve performance through profiling, bottleneck analysis, architectural simplification, targeted optimization, and moving expensive work out of critical interaction paths so systems remain responsive as document complexity and user activity scale

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 
Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks

- 
6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

- 
Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience designing clean API contracts and service boundaries, including thoughtful data models, versioning, validation, error handling, documentation, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience building distributed, concurrent, collaborative, or low-latency systems, such as collaboration tools, MMO games, shared-state systems, messaging protocols, or other low-latency user experiences, with familiarity across synchronization, consistency, event ordering, latency, failure modes, and performance trade-offs

- 
Exposure to complex systems with rich object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, selection mechanics, and performance-sensitive user interactions is a strong plus

- 
Interest in AI-enabled product capabilities, or hands-on experience building or integrating them in production, such as intelligent editing, automation, recommendations, semantic document understanding, or collaboration features powered by AI

- 
Performance optimization experience, including profiling, bottleneck analysis, memory and CPU efficiency, latency reduction, and responsiveness as document complexity and user activity scale

- 
Familiarity with parallel processing, off-main-thread architectures, rendering pipelines, background computation, or other multithreaded systems is a plus

- 
Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure engineering work

- 
Communication and collaboration skills, with a low-ego approach to working with Product, Design, and Engineering, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to technical discussions, collaborate across teams, and help improve team engineering practices

- 
Comfort operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments or scale-ups is a plus

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Equal Opportunity 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Director, Rare Disease Product Marketing & Sales Enablement
description:
Position Overview 

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing & Sales Enablement to shape how Zenith genomics is positioned, explained, and adopted in the rare disease market. Rare disease diagnostics is a market where the standard playbook doesn't apply: the ordering audience is specialized, the diagnostic odyssey is long, and every clinician interaction has to count.

This leader owns the work that turns strategy into field results: how our value is told, what the sales team carries into the room, how well the field is trained, and how quickly a new account moves from first conversation to routine ordering. You will partner closely with the marketing leader who owns clinical community engagement (KOLs, conferences, and speaker programs), and with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and corporate Commercial Operations, to ensure a single, integrated go-to-market plan.

The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset, and is equally comfortable in a messaging workshop, a field ride-along, and a funnel dashboard. As the business scales, this role is expected to grow into a team.

Key Responsibilities 

Product Marketing & Messaging

- 
Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and the core messaging framework for Zenith, translating complex genomic science into clear value propositions for clinicians, genetic counselors, and health systems.

- 
Collateral & Content: Lead development of sales and customer-facing assets (brochures, leave-behinds, clinical summaries, sell sheets, digital content), including the claims library and MLR / compliance review workflow.

- 
Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a current view of the rare disease genomics landscape and equip the field with differentiated, evidence-based positioning.

- 
Evidence Integration: Work with Medical and Clinical teams to convert new publications, real-world data, and utilization insights into messaging and field tools.

- 
Launch Support: Own the product marketing workstream of the Zenith launch plan, including launch messaging, asset readiness, and field communications.

Sales Enablement & Customer Adoption

- 
Field Enablement: Design and run onboarding, training, and ongoing education for the sales team on the science, the competitive landscape, and the value story; equip reps to be credible with geneticists and specialists.

- 
Customer Adoption Journey: Map and continuously improve the path from first call to routine ordering, including implementation, EMR integration touchpoints, and utilization resources, to shorten time to adoption.

- 
Sales Interface: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner to Sales leadership; run regular field feedback loops and translate what reps and customers are telling us into messaging, tools, and priorities.

- 
Market Access Pull-Through: Partner with Market Access and Reimbursement to convert coverage and payer developments into field-ready tools and messaging.

Commercial Insights & Targeting

- 
Segmentation & Targeting: Partner with Sales and corporate analytics to define customer segments and account prioritization using clinical, claims, and market data; inform target lists and field focus.

- 
Performance Tracking: Define the KPIs that track funnel health, ordering behavior, and adoption for the BU, and use insights to adjust messaging, enablement, and resource focus.

- 
Sales Operations Liaison: Represent the Rare Disease BU's needs to corporate Commercial Operations (CRM, reporting, forecasting, and ordering workflow) and ensure the field has clean data and low-friction processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- 
Integrated Planning: Partner with the clinical community marketing lead (KOL, conferences, speaker programs) so that field events, thought-leader engagement, and product messaging operate as one plan.

- 
Matrix Collaboration: Serve as the commercial connective tissue across Sales, Medical Affairs, Product, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and Legal.

- 
Budget & Vendor Stewardship: Manage assigned budget and agency / vendor partners with a focus on measurable ROI.

- 
Team Growth: Build the business case and hire for additional capacity (for example, sales training, content, or analytics) as the business scales.

Qualifications 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Marketing; MBA, MPH, or advanced scientific degree preferred.

- 8+ years of commercial experience in diagnostics, genomics, or life sciences, including product marketing, sales enablement, commercial strategy, or sales operations.

- Demonstrated success supporting or leading product launches in a complex clinical diagnostics or specialty setting.

- Experience in genomics, rare disease, or precision diagnostics strongly preferred.

- Experience partnering directly with a field sales organization, including training, tools, and CRM / analytics.

- Experience managing or developing a team is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

- 
Messaging Craft: Ability to learn and distill complex clinical and genomic data into compelling, compliant narratives for HCPs and field teams.

- 
Analytical Rigor: Comfortable interpreting segmentation, funnel, and commercial performance data to drive decisions.

- 
Operational Excellence: Track record of building scalable commercial processes, enablement programs, and cross-functional workflows.

- 
Reimbursement & Access Savvy: Working understanding of diagnostic reimbursement, LDT considerations, and payer dynamics.

- 
Strategic Agility: Comfort operating in white space where market data is limited and the playbook is still being written.

- 
Collaborative Leadership: Influences without authority, and builds strong partnerships with clinical and scientific experts.

Why This Role Matters 

In rare disease, every day matters. The clarity with which we explain Zenith's value, and the speed at which a new account adopts it, directly affect how quickly a family reaches a diagnosis. You will build the messaging, field readiness, and adoption path that make that possible.

The "Rare" Candidate Profile 

What We Are Looking For

Mindset

Builder who sees a small, specialized market as an opportunity to get the details right.

Field Credibility

Earns trust with sales teams by delivering tools and training that reps actually use.

Communication

Sophisticated enough for a PhD; practical enough for a sales rep on their first day.

Collaboration

Pairs with deep clinical and community expertise to create one integrated plan.

Leadership

A mentor who builds resilient, mission-driven teams.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$186,600—$233,300 USD

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera ’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

- Annual performance incentive bonus

- Long-term equity awards

- Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

- 401(k) with company match

- Generous paid time off and company holidays

- Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range 

$186,600—$233,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera ™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera , you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

title: U.S. Client Partner — Executive Search Risk, Compliance & Cybersecurity United S
description:
This is a remote position.

The opportunity

MastarRec is a retained executive search firm focused on senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory and Cybersecurity leadership. We are expanding our U.S. client-development capability and are looking for an experienced, commercially credible professional who already understands how to build senior-level relationships and originate executive-search business.

This is not a high-volume recruiter role and it is not a salaried employee vacancy. It is designed as an independent business-to-business contractor relationship for someone who can create and develop their own U.S. client opportunities, while using MastarRec 's brand, executive-search capability and agreed commercial resources to convert suitable opportunities into retained assignments.

What you will do 
- Develop your own relationships with U.S. CEOs, CROs, CCOs, CISOs and other senior decision-makers in Financial Services, FinTech and related regulated markets.

- Identify genuine business, regulatory, growth, succession, risk and leadership pressures that may create a need for senior executive capability.

- Originate qualified client opportunities and introduce them to MastarRec for retained executive-search discussions.

- Lead or participate in commercial conversations where appropriate, with Tariq Masood, Founder & CEO, available for founder-to-executive and closing conversations.

- Maintain accurate opportunity and relationship records using agreed MastarRec processes.

- Protect the MastarRec brand through professional, relationship-led business development; no indiscriminate candidate or client spam.

What this opportunity is not 
- It is not a fixed-hours call-center role.

- It is not an employee position with a guaranteed salary, employee benefits or prescribed daily working schedule.

- It is not primarily a candidate-sourcing desk.

- It is not an invitation to mass-message prospects or represent unverified vacancies.

Requirements

Who we want to speak with 
- Experienced executive-search, recruitment, staffing, retained-search or professional-services business developers with U.S. market credibility.

- Professionals comfortable speaking directly with C-suite and senior Risk, Compliance, Regulatory or Cybersecurity leaders.

- People who can independently decide how, when and where to develop their market and who are comfortable being accountable for commercial results.

- Professionals with an existing network in U.S. Financial Services, FinTech, banking, payments, insurance, asset/wealth management, cybersecurity or adjacent regulated sectors.

- Individuals who value consultative conversations and long-term relationships over transactional vacancy chasing.

90-day pilot success measures 
- Qualified senior decision-maker conversations.

- Client discovery meetings with genuine leadership or succession issues.

·Retained-search opportunities created.

- Retained proposals issued and assignments won.

- Collected search revenue from contractor-originated business.

- Quality of client relationships and commercial intelligence, not raw dial or message volume.

How to apply Please send a concise introduction explaining your U.S. market background, the sectors and senior decision-makers you know best, and examples of executive-search, recruitment or professional-services business you have personally originated. We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate relationship-led business development rather than high-volume outreach. Company: MastarRec Limited | 

Founder & CEO: Tariq Masood

Benefits

Commercial model

The proposed pilot is performance-based. The final commission schedule will be stated in the written contractor agreement. Our intended starting model is a substantial share of MastarRec 's net collected search fees on qualifying new client business personally originated by the contractor. Commission becomes payable only after the relevant client payment has been received and cleared by MastarRec , subject to the agreement's account-ownership, refund, replacement, tax and clawback provisions.

For discussion, Commission is 22% of qualifying net search fees actually collected by MastarRec from new client business personally originated by the contractor. The final structure may vary according to the scope of the contractor's role, whether MastarRec provides delivery support, and applicable legal/tax requirements.

Independent contractor basis

The successful professional will be expected to operate as an independent businessperson, subject to the final written agreement and applicable federal and state law. The contractor will ordinarily control the manner, means, timing and location of their work; remain responsible for their own ordinary business expenses, taxes and insurance; and, subject to confidentiality, conflict and account-protection obligations, remain free to provide services to other clients. MastarRec will define required commercial outcomes, brand/confidentiality standards and client-account protections rather than prescribing day-to-day working methods.

Important notice

This specification describes MastarRec 's intended commercial model and is not a legal determination of worker status. Worker classification depends on the actual facts and circumstances and may differ under federal, state and local law. MastarRec will complete appropriate legal/tax review before engagement. No candidate should rely on the title, commission method or written agreement alone as determining independent-contractor status.

title: Kernel Developer - KernelCare ELS Team
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Worldwide) – Focus on LATAM time zones (Americas)

Employment Type: Full-time, B2B / Independent Contractor (or W2 for US-based candidates)

About the Position & Company 

Our client is a global leader in Linux infrastructure and security solutions, known for pioneering automated live patching technologies that enable enterprises to apply critical kernel updates without reboots or downtime. They also provide extended support for end-of-life Linux distributions, helping organizations maintain compliance and enterprise-grade security.

With a fully remote team of 250+ professionals worldwide and a client base of over 4,500 enterprise customers—including major tech industry leaders—they deliver robust infrastructure solutions across the US, Europe, Latin America, and beyond.

Key Responsibilities 

- 
Research & Analysis: Investigate upstream security (CVE) and bug fixes; analyze patch dependencies and impact on legacy kernels.

- 
Backporting: Manually backport Linux kernel patches to older kernel versions used in RPM-based and Debian-based distributions.

- 
Conflict Resolution: Resolve merge conflicts between upstream changes and target kernel codebases.

- 
Kernel Packaging: Build and rebuild kernel source and binary packages using reproducible build environments for RPM and Debian ecosystems.

- 
Validation & Testing: Validate patched kernels through build tests, runtime tests, and regression analysis to ensure stability.

- 
Tooling & Automation: Enhance internal workflows (patch preparation, build automation, validation pipelines) using Python, Go, and Shell scripting.

- 
AI Integration: Leverage agentic/AI-assisted development tools to accelerate tasks, while rigorously verifying every generated output.

- 
Documentation & Collaboration: Document technical decisions, participate in code reviews, and communicate clearly with team members across time zones.

Requirements

Must-Have 

- 
Strong C proficiency and hands-on Linux debugging skills.

- 
Proven commercial experience in Linux kernel development—specifically patching, backporting, or debugging.

- Solid experience with Git , GNU build tools (make, autotools), and standard Linux developer utilities.

- Experience building Linux kernels or distribution packages from source.

- Scripting and automation skills: Python, Go, or Shell .

- Practical exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Codeium, or similar), with a disciplined approach to code verification.

- 
English: Intermediate or higher (B1+), both written and spoken—you’ll be working in an international team and communicating in English daily.

- Strong ownership mindset, balanced technical judgment, and ability to articulate trade-offs.

Nice-to-Have 

- Experience with RPM/SRPM or Debian kernel packaging .

- Familiarity with security patching , CVE analysis, and extended lifecycle maintenance.

- Working knowledge of Docker, QEMU, Jenkins , or other CI systems.

- Experience designing kernel validation tests, analyzing core dumps, and investigating regressions.

Candidate Profile (Cultural Fit) 

- 
Hands-on practitioner: You love working directly with kernel code, not just theorizing.

- 
Methodical and detail-oriented: Kernel patching requires precision, reproducibility, and thorough validation.

- 
Ownership-driven: You take responsibility for outcomes, document your work, and proactively communicate risks.

- 
AI-curious but cautious: You embrace AI tools to accelerate development but never skip verification.

- 
Remote-first compatible: You thrive in async environments with minimal supervision and clear communication.

Benefits

- 
100% remote work with flexible hours — work from anywhere in the world (focus on LATAM-friendly time zones).

- 
24 paid vacation days + 10 national holidays + unlimited sick leave.

- 
Private medical insurance compensation.

- 
Coworking space and sports/fitness reimbursement.

- 
Professional development budget — conferences, courses, certifications.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
description:

URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ 

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. 

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Mobile or cross-platform app development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Multi-user marketplace platforms

- User authentication and account management

- Payment gateway integrations

- Databases and APIs

- Third-party integrations

- Dashboards and reporting

- Secure, scalable application architecture

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Testing, maintenance, and optimization

- Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

- Your resume or LinkedIn profile

- Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on

- What you personally worked on for those projects

- Your experience using AI in development

- Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

title: Senior Java Developer

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. 

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. - With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

- You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

- Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

- You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

- You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

- You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

- You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

- You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

- You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

- You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

- You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

- An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

- The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

- An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

- A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

- A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

- Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. Behind that experience is a complex infrastructure ecosystem that powers reliability, performance, measurement, and efficiency across the platform. As Pinterest grows, it’s increasingly important that we understand these systems clearly so we can make smarter decisions for both Pinners and the business.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Infrastructure Data Science team. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to make Pinterest’s infrastructure more measurable, intelligible, and actionable. Depending on the area, your work may span app performance, shopping infrastructure, metrics quality, infrastructure governance, or site reliability. You’ll help build the data foundations, measurement systems, and analytical frameworks that enable Pinterest to optimize core technical systems and make better product and infrastructure decisions.

What you’ll do: 

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to improve how Pinterest measures, understands, and optimizes its infrastructure:

- Partner with engineering teams to define, measure, and improve the health, quality, and efficiency of Pinterest’s infrastructure systems.

- Build and refine metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that make complex technical systems more understandable and actionable.

- Strengthen data foundations by improving metric definitions, auditing data quality, and contributing to pipeline and measurement improvements where needed.

- Design and analyze experiments, investigations, and deep dives to quantify the impact of infrastructure changes on user experience, reliability, and business outcomes.

- Translate ambiguous technical problems into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for engineering and platform partners.

- Support high-priority investigations and decision-making related to infrastructure performance, reliability, cost, and measurement quality.

- Identify opportunities to improve how Pinterest measures and optimizes infrastructure across a range of domains, such as performance, shopping infrastructure, governance, metrics quality, and site reliability.

What we’re looking for: 

- Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience.

- Strong SQL and analytical programming skills, with experience working through messy, imperfect data and building reliable metrics and datasets.

- Experience partnering on or contributing to production-ready data pipelines, measurement systems, or foundational data work that improves data quality and usability.

- Solid foundation in experimentation and measurement, with the ability to design analyses, interpret results rigorously, and partner effectively with engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear analytical workstreams and actionable recommendations.

- Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to engineering, product, and platform stakeholders.

- Ability to operate independently, prioritize across both longer-term projects and fast-turn inbound requests, and drive work forward in a dynamic environment.

- Curiosity and a builder mindset, with excitement for improving messy systems and creating more scalable, trustworthy measurement foundations.
